dct_description_sm:
Data set is comprised of tenanted dispositions by the Crown and include Leases, Licenses of Occupation, Land Use Permits, Beach Management Agreements and Easements.

Additional Time Period Information: date the class was implemented in NRVIS

Pieces of relevant Information stored in the Land Information System (LIS) and Land Use Permit System (LUPS) has been included to be shown alongside the related spatial locations in CLDISP.

This data can be viewed in the LIO Editor and Mapper, and will also be included on data delivery for internal MNRF users. The data provided by LIS and LUPs is there for user reference it cannot be edited or modified.
